name: Career Mode
author: Sixth Front
description: Built into the game and always on: CAREER MODE on the main menu. Story missions for every kind of battle (infantry, tanks, aviation and naval), each career running from the First World War through the Second to the present day. A mission sets up its own battle, map, armies and weather, puts you in your seat and plays out a script: radio calls, waves, objectives, and the crew or section fighting beside you. Aboard the B-17G Lucky Lady you move between the six gun positions as the crew calls them, then fly the bomb run over Schweinfurt through the Norden sight. Command HMS Lion at Jutland, a MAS torpedo boat against the Szent István, HMS Rodney against the Bismarck and the destroyer Johnston off Samar, in twenty-three period warships. Go over the top on the Somme in a Brodie helmet with a Lee-Enfield, take the guns at Brecourt Manor with an M1 Garand and TNT, hold Pavlov's house with a PPSh-41. Missions open one after another; finishing one pays research points, silver and gold into the RESEARCH screen.
